currentDirectorDisposition.finding: No selected W17N acquired card or prepared ordinary spell in the bound records establishes an operational Undead-to-non-Undead transition with a qualified acquisition and paid activation history.
currentDirectorDisposition.existingAlternative: Return333 states: alternatively submit an explicit separately scoped authoring/obligation-revision request. This packet is that request only; the alternative has not been granted.

requestedDirectorDecision.question: May a separately scoped, conditional TEST_ONLY eligibility-loss procedure test satisfy the static authored-review obligation for SH333-R02 while the actual provider/source qualification remains a separate unresolved requirement for any source-qualified acceptance or application?

proposedTestInput.recipient: An abstract branch-local relay recipient, identified only as R02-TEST-RECIPIENT; no campaign identity is asserted.
proposedTestInput.preTransitionState: For the conditional logic test only, the recipient has one active Decay control relation and one unexecuted relation order. This is a stipulated test state, not proof of a qualified source history.
proposedTestInput.transition: At a named test event, stipulate only that the recipient creature type changes from Undead to non-Undead. No spell, operational provider, caster, acquisition, paid activation, duration source, or campaign event is named or asserted.
proposedTestInput.reversion: A later named test event may stipulate return to Undead solely to check whether the ended relation/order remains ended. The decision request does not prescribe a real-world duration or source for that reversion.
proposedTestInput.numericState: No hit points, maximum hit points, armor class, save values, resource counts, or timestamps are invented here. Any later witness must bind its exact values and timing if the Director authorizes construction.

expectedConsequencesToValidateIfAuthoriz: At the Undead-eligibility-loss event, the affected relay relation ends immediately and its pending order is cancelled.
Clear any reservation immediately while retaining costs and spent shared guards already incurred.
Restore the original controller prospectively without healing, a fresh opportunity, a new Action, or replay.
Recalculate the recipient maxima and defensive modifiers under its bound effects; clamp current HP downward if the maximum falls, without healing.
If the test type later reverts to Undead, do not revive the cancelled relation or replay its stale order; a new relation must satisfy the actual shared guards and source rules.
requestedDirectorDecision.requiredBoundary: A YES ruling would authorize only the conditional static procedure test, not a fictional provider/acquisition/activation or source-qualified encounter. The actual-provider qualification remains explicit and unresolved unless separately established from source.
requestedDirectorDecision.responseRequested: Return an exact YES/NO ruling bound to this packet. If YES, state the narrow revised static-review obligation and the exact owner-adoption scope needed before witness construction. If NO, retain the existing hold and identify the minimum missing source or decision.
